title: API
description: Manage client API keys and connect clients to the proxy.
access.title: API access
access.stateOn: Clients must send an API key
access.stateOff: Any client can call the proxy
access.enabledApiKeyRequired: Create and enable at least one API key before you require one.
access.discardBody: Your API access change is not saved yet. Leave this page anyway?
keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create a key per client. Set token or credit limits; 0 means unlimited.
keys.emptyBody: Create a key to give a client access.
keys.caption: API keys
keys.name: Name
keys.limitReachedHint: The key reached a limit, so the proxy disabled it. Raise the limit or reset usage, then enable it.
keys.usageResetDisabledHint: A key disabled by its limit stays disabled until you enable it.
keys.confirmDeleteBody: Clients that use it can no longer call the proxy. This cannot be undone.
keys.lockoutWarning: API keys are required and this is the last enabled key. Every client is locked out until you enable a key.
created.title: New API key
created.body: Copy it into your client now. You can copy it again from the table.
form.name: Name
form.customKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to generate a key.
form.customKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key.
form.invalidTokenLimit: Token limit must be a whole number, 0 or more.
form.invalidCreditLimit: Credit limit must be 0 or more.
form.createFailed: Could not create the API key
form.saveFailed: Could not save the API key
endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Point your clients at these URLs.
endpoints.authRequired: Clients send an API key as {bearer} or {xApiKey}. Use a key from this page, not the admin password.
endpoints.authOptional: API keys are not required now, so clients need no key. When you require one, clients send it as {bearer} or {xApiKey}, not the admin password.
snippets.title: Client setup
snippets.description: Examples for this proxy. Set {env} to one of your API keys first.
snippets.anyKeyWorks: API keys are not required now, so any value works.
snippets.claudeCodeHint: Run in a shell, then start Claude Code in the same shell.
snippets.codexHint: Add to {file}. Codex reads the key from {env}.
